claim_reviews.subject: English cue: smartphone

claim_reviews.conclusion: Appropriate for contrasting the localized Indonesian and Malaysian forms, while recognizing that English smartphone is also used informally in both contexts.
claim_reviews.subject: Final relation: different-common-word

claim_reviews.conclusion: No false friend is present; ponsel pintar and telefon pintar are transparent, semantically matching compounds rather than misleading cross-variety forms.
